amount_at_least.description: Fires only when the document's debits in the base currency are at least this; leave it out for any amount.

document_type.description: The kind of document it watches, such as bill, invoice or journal (the kinds whose postings tell people); leave it out for any kind.

recipients.description: The active members told (user IDs). Each must hold the right to view the document, which is checked every time the rule fires.
